title: TabBorrowParams
description: Params for `tool.tab_borrow`. Moves a *user* tab into the requesting session's Agent Window, recording its original window / index so `tab_return` (or session_stop) can put it back.

confirm.description: Override the browser confirmation preference for this borrow. Unattended sessions always skip confirmation.

confirmation_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for user confirmation (default 60 seconds).
